name: manual_f41b79
claim: A later explicit do-not-stop constraint overrides earlier process permission; isolate model tests with a closed endpoint and leave engines services and workers untouched.

decisions.notes: The operator reversed earlier engine-stop permission, so no process was stopped and test shells used a closed local endpoint.

rationale: The operator reversed earlier engine-stop permission, so no process was stopped and test shells used a closed local endpoint.
